bills_cash_fields.name: bills_cash_fields
bills_cash_fields.value:
("bills"."method" = 'cash' and "bills"."tendered" is not null and "bills"."change_due" is not null and "bills"."tendered" >= "bills"."total" and "bills"."change_due" = "bills"."tendered" - "bills"."total")
        or ("bills"."method" = 'qr' and "bills"."tendered" is null and "bills"."change_due" is null)

bills_void_fields.name: bills_void_fields
bills_void_fields.value:
("bills"."status" = 'paid' and "bills"."void_reason" is null and "bills"."voided_by" is null and "bills"."voided_at" is null)
        or ("bills"."status" = 'void' and char_length("bills"."void_reason") between 1 and 200 and "bills"."voided_by" is not null and "bills"."voided_at" is not null)

chart_entries_tooth.name: chart_entries_tooth
chart_entries_tooth.value:
"chart_entries"."tooth" between 11 and 18 or "chart_entries"."tooth" between 21 and 28 or "chart_entries"."tooth" between 31 and 38
        or "chart_entries"."tooth" between 41 and 48 or "chart_entries"."tooth" between 51 and 55 or "chart_entries"."tooth" between 61 and 65
        or "chart_entries"."tooth" between 71 and 75 or "chart_entries"."tooth" between 81 and 85

chart_entries_void_complete.name: chart_entries_void_complete
chart_entries_void_complete.value: ("chart_entries"."voided_at" is null) = ("chart_entries"."voided_by" is null) and ("chart_entries"."voided_at" is null) = ("chart_entries"."void_reason" is null)

dentist_schedules_grid.name: dentist_schedules_grid
dentist_schedules_grid.value:
extract(minute from "dentist_schedules"."start_time")::int % 15 = 0 and extract(minute from "dentist_schedules"."end_time")::int % 15 = 0
        and extract(second from "dentist_schedules"."start_time") = 0 and extract(second from "dentist_schedules"."end_time") = 0
